vb_textbox.text: There appears to be two groups of gnomes. One group gives a red basket and the other group gives a yellow basket. The gnomes that are reddish in colour have the red baskets and other colour gnomes have the yellow basket. At the start of the game, try to identify which gnomes correspond to which group, then aim to pick the group that gives the highest payoff. When the payoff from that group shrinks towards zero, switch groups and you'll probably find that the group you just switched to is giving a higher payoff. Use your intuition to switch between groups during the game to achieve the highest payoff.
